notes.title: Homestead Patch is now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440158/9659c80fbffff98e5dc5cdd6589195a1e5791d08.png[/img]

[b]This Patch focus on improving the Crafting System of the game as well as updating the GUI[/b]


[b]New Updated GUI Interface
Completely Revised Crafting System
New Mining-Stance Available
New Block-Type Added
Various Smaller Fixes and Additions[/b]


[b]New Crafting System:[/b]
- All Crafting now shares a common resource: Resource Points
- Materials such as Stone, Wood, Iron etc. gives different Resource Points
- Items can be Salvaged for Resource Points
- Collect & Learn new Blueprints to Craft
- Scan & Build Complete Structures
- Gathering Resource Points also yields an XP Reward


[b]New Mining-Stance:[/b]
- Press & Hold Use Button to start Mining
- Mine Blocks to Gather Blueprints
- Mining Ground and finding Ore Veins Yields Bonus Resource Points


[b]New Block-Type:[/b]
- Impeding Blocks
- Deals Damage to anyone passing over
- 3 Different Types Added
- Collectable & Craftable

Minor hot-fixes are expected as this Patch goes Love


Happy Gaming!




[i]Please report any bugs/issues either at the Community Hub or directly at admin@borderstrain.com[/i]

notes.title: BorderStrain Mastery Patch Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h1] This is the Third Larger Patch for BorderStrain [/h1]

[b] This Patch focus on improving the overall Skills used in the game  [/b]

Multiple Skills Replaced
Multiple New Skills Added
Multiple Changes to Existing Skills

Melee Weapons have been damage increased significantly
Update Melee Attack Effects
Update Teleport Effect
Added A Few New Area Visual Effects
Updated Projectile Explosion Secondary Effects
Added Ambient Sounds From Multiple Blocks
Various Bug Fixes

[h1] Following Skills have been Changed: [/h1]

Offensive: Rapid Fire
-Attacks performed while Active now always are Instant-Hit type

Offensive: Burst-Shot
-Projectiles spawned now has reduced Area-Effect


[h1]Following Skills Have Been Removed:[/h1]

Defensive: Clone
-Replaced with Infest

Defensive: Active Armour
-Replaced with Cocoon

Stealth: Pull-Loot
-Replaced with Death-Stance

Stealth: Negate-Attack
-Replaced with Nova Strike

Offensive: Flamethrower
-Replaced with Barrage-Stance

Offensive: Grenade-Volley
-Replaced with Berserk

Utility: Auto-Repair
-Replaced with Plasma Fence


[h1]Following Skills Have Been Added:[/h1]

Basic: Empower
-Increased the power of all other active Skills while active

Basic: Demolition Charge
-Places a Demolition Charge that explodes after some time dealing Area-Damage and Bonus Damage against Blocks

Basic: Priomordial Rage
-Each Kill while active adds a Stack. Each Stack gives Bonus Damage

Basic: Heavy Blow
-Next Melee Attack deal Bonus Damage

Defensive: Cocoon
-Creates a protective Cocoon while Active which Prevents Damage and increased Health Regeneration

Defensive: Infest
-Deal Damage to target Creature. If killed it spawns a number of Friendly Spiders

Stealth: Nova Strike
-Teleport towards closest Enemy and perform multiple Melee Attacks, each dealing Bonus Damage

Stealth Death-Stance
-While Sniping Attacks now Pierce and damages all Enemies along bullet-path

Offensive: Barrage-Stance
-While in Heavy Stance Attacks also spawn Secondary Projectiles upon impact

Offensive: Berserk
-Player Receives Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction for each % Health missing while Active

Utility: Plasma Fence
-Drag & Drop to Place a energy fence dealing Damage to all Creatures passing through while Active

notes.title: BorderStrain Wayfaring Patch Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34440158/ee08f91e520293e2662eec8b0445b742b9dc37ab.png[/img]

[h1]This is the second larger content Patch for BorderStrain - Early Access.[/h1]

The focus of this Patch is primarily to expand the World Environment as well as add new tools for the Map-Maker which will allow for larger and better future content.


[h1]
With the Wayfaring Patch the game now support 25 times larger custom areas, as well as a lot of newly generated Areas. Each city now has a Bounty-Broker which can supply custom Quests and the Map-Maker now has support for making your own Quests which can appear at the Bounty-Broker!

Many new Blocks has also been added to allow for increased variation of areas and now also supports placement of Creature-Spawners which are invisible blocks that can be used to pre-populate and area with specific Creatures.[/h1]


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sUSicC8qHQw


[u][b]Summary of Main Features: [/b][/u]

[b]Super-Compound Areas:[/b]
Special locations can now be designed which are 25 times bigger then previous maximum size. This will allow for the design of much more varying locations to adventure into!

[b]Bounty-Broker:[/b]
Rather then chasing NPCs for Quests each City now houses a Bounty-Broker which can be visited to aquire region specific Quests. The Map-Maker also has a new support for any new Quests in Player-Created Custom Expansions to appear at the Bounty-Broker

[b]New Areas To Visit:[/b]
A lot of new Content has been created in form of new Areas which can be found throuought the game!

[b]New Blocks:[/b]
Multiple new Blocks have been added to increase the amount of variation in newly created areas.

[b]Enemy-Spawners:[/b]
A new invisible Block type which can be used in the Map-Maker to Pre-Populate an Area with specific Creatures.

[b]Resting:[/b]
If all Players in the Game are resting then the game speeds-up. This allows to camp out the night for those Adventurers who prefer exploring during the day!


This Patch also contains various smaller bug fixes and patches


[u][b]NOTE:[/b][/u] For existing games, no areas which have already been generated will be replaced. Either create a new game, manually clear the data or travel to new non-generated areas.


[i]Please report any bugs/issues either at the Community Hub or directly at admin@borderstrain.com[/i]

notes.title: BorderStrain Pangea Patch Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1P3WOBxvwX0


[h1]This is the first larger content Patch for BorderStrain - Early Access.

The focus of this Patch is primarily to expand the World Environment as well as add more gameplay in the form of new areas, new items and new special blocks!
[/h1]

[h1]With the Pangea Patch the world of Pangea now houses new, more alien areas. The World-Generator has been updated to provide better variation of the game world and new enivronmental conent and effects such multiple new Alien Trees, new Blocks and fog during Dawn and Dusk has been added![/h1]



For new Loot the Patch adds Sigils, Crystals and Log-Entries. 

[h1]Sigils:[/h1]
These are items which can be Infused in the Players Weapon to provide unique and powerful effetcs. Sigils gains XP and the more a Sigil is used the more Powerful it becomes. One intention here is also that it opens up for more Player Builds. There are a total of 12 different Sigils to be found in the game.

[h1]Crystals:[/h1]
Crystals are a new typ of Consumable. They can provide different one-time Effects, such as an XP-Reward, a Terraforming Event or to control the Weather and Spawn-Rate of of Creatures and Enemies.

[h1]Log-Entries:[/h1]
Log-Entries can now be found dropped in the game. They provide different short historical data of Pangea. The more Entries found the more backstory of Pangea can be discovered. Once the Player no longer feels a need for them they can also be Consumed for an XP Reward.

[h1]Special Lootable Blocks:[/h1]
A new type of special blocks which can be found in the World. These special blocks, such as tainted alien eggs or floating crystals, can be destroyed for a large Loot Reward. However, they can also trigger dangerous events once destroyed so thread carefully!


This Patch also containes various smaller bug fixes and patches!



Please report any bugs found on the Community Forums or directly to admin@borderstrain.com. 

We will be extra vigilant to hot-fix any potential bugs now during the release of this Patch!

notes.title: Early Access Release May 24
notes.notes:
BorderStrain will be officially released for Early Access May 24 9am PDT! 

I hope to that you will join in the adventures ahead!


I have really tried to get the game as smooth and bug free as possible but please bear in mind that this game is completely solo developed and I will appreciate any feedback in the upcoming early access release and I will try to address any unexpected issues as quickly as possible!

Although the release into Early Access is a huge stepping stone the intention is to continue adding and improving upon the game whilst in Early Access to try to provide as good experience to you guys as possible!
